shortDescription: Manage Hetzner Cloud Load Balancer targets

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: ip
options.description: An IP from a Hetzner Dedicated Server, needs to belongs to the same user as the project. Required if I(type) is ip

options.name: label_selector
options.description: A Label Selector that will be used to determine the targets dynamically Required if I(type) is label_selector

options.name: load_balancer
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud Load Balancer.

options.name: server
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud Server. Required if I(type) is server

options.name: use_private_ip
options.description: Route the traffic over the private IP of the Load Balancer through a Hetzner Cloud Network. Load Balancer needs to be attached to a network. See M(hetzner.hcloud.load_balancer_network)
